title: The Classics Collection
description: Monumental works that have withstood decades and centuries, continuing to illuminate the human condition with unmatched depth and lyrical grace.
intro: A classic is a book that has never finished saying what it has to say. We selected these clothbound and deckle-edged volumes not as museum artifacts, but as urgent companions for contemporary living.

title: Hidden Literary Gems
description: Lesser-known masterworks, quiet revelations, and cult classics curated for discerning readers seeking uncommon discoveries.
intro: The truest literary treasures rarely shout from airport bestseller racks. These are the books passed hand-to-hand among poets, translators, and thoughtful bookshop proprietors.

title: Books Worth Rereading
description: Books that reward returning to them at different seasons of your life, revealing subtle layers each time you turn their pages.
intro: When you reread a great book, you don't see more in it than you did before; you see more in you than there was before. These are the lifelong volumes on our private shelves.

title: Philosophy & Thought
description: Foundational texts from ancient stoics to existential thinkers, offering clarity and grounding in a chaotic world.
intro: Philosophy at its finest is not dry academic jargon, but an intimate manual for how to bear sorrow, navigate choice, and cultivate an unshakeable inner citadel.

title: Fiction Essentials
description: Mesmerizing narratives, spellbinding prose, and unforgettable characters that celebrate the sublime narrative art.
intro: Fiction allows us to live a thousand lives before we die. From the gothic shadows of Barcelona to futuristic allegories of empathy, immerse yourself in our essential modern fiction.

title: The Weekend Shelf
description: Cozy, absorbing, and atmospheric reads designed to accompany a steaming pot of coffee, soft rain, and unhurried afternoons.
intro: Books meant to be savored in comfortable armchairs over two leisurely days. Atmospheric bookstores, magical Tokyo cafes, and quiet winter mornings in rural Ireland.

title: Under ₹299 Collection
description: Every reader deserves access to brilliant books. Discover world-class fiction, philosophy, and timeless poetry under ₹299.
intro: Great literature should never be an exclusive luxury. We partner with classical publishers to offer these seminal volumes at accessible price points without compromising paper quality or typography.

title: Editor's Recommendations
description: The personal favorites of our editorial team—books that inspired our manifesto and embody the literary soul of QITAVRO.
intro: These are the books we press into the hands of our closest friends. Each has demonstrated an extraordinary fidelity to language, atmosphere, and authentic insight.
